request.query: Weighted order infDegree polynomial bound at rational tuple from integer coefficient heights

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.min_weightedOrder_le_add
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  min (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f) (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g) ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f + g)

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] → [OrderBot M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → {σ : Type u_3} → [AddCommMonoid M] → (σ → M) → MvPolynomial σ R → M → Prop

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (w : τ → ℕ),
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
      ⨅ d, ⨅ (_ : (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0), (Finsupp.weight (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ∘ a)) d ≤
        MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (MvPowerSeries.subst a f)
